boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-purchase ways for Taylor students to gather, move, study, reflect, or explore on and near campus.

cards.title: Browse the Boren Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Helena Memorial Hall
cards.notes: Meet at Helena Memorial Hall and take in the Western and Indiana art collections together. Check the listed gallery hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art stop with permanent collections in a historic campus building.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that admission to the Boren Art Gallery is free.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours listed by Taylor: Wednesday noon–5 p.m.; Monday and Friday by appointment. Enter through Helena Memorial Hall's main entrance.

cards.entity_name: Use Zondervan Library in the building
cards.title: Settle in at Zondervan Library
cards.subtitle: Zondervan Library
cards.notes: Bring a friend, choose a table, and use the library’s in-building materials or research computers during normal access hours. Borrowing is a separate service.
cards.short_summary: An indoor study-and-research hang open for in-building use without a purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says anyone may use materials in Zondervan Library during normal access hours; its community borrower card applies to checkout, not in-building use.
cards.source_title: Taylor's Zondervan Library Outlines Services for the Community
cards.access_notes: In-building use is open during normal access hours. Taylor notes that community borrowing requires a paid card, so do not plan on checkout for this hang.

cards.title: Work out at The Well
cards.subtitle: Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Plan a low-key workout together using the weights, treadmills, ellipticals, and other equipment. Confirm break-period changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A student fitness room with equipment Taylor identifies as free to students.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says athletic-facility space and workout equipment are free to students, and identifies The Well as a KSAC feature with workout equipment.
cards.access_notes: Taylor lists Well hours as Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–11 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m.–10 p.m., and Sunday 2–10 p.m.; closed for chapel Mon/Wed/Fri 10–11 a.m.

cards.title: Walk the indoor track
cards.subtitle: Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Meet for a few laps and conversation on the complete indoor track. Use the KSAC schedule and respect closures or activity already in progress.
cards.short_summary: A weather-proof walking or running option inside Taylor’s recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor identifies a complete indoor track in the Kesler Student Activities Center and states its athletic-facility space is free to students.
cards.access_notes: The KSAC closes for chapel Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 10–11 a.m.; hours may change during University breaks.

cards.title: Bring a group for casual games
cards.subtitle: Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a simple court game with friends in the Fieldhouse rather than assuming a programmed session. Check availability with the KSAC before you go.
cards.short_summary: Multi-purpose recreation space in Taylor’s student activities center.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor lists the Fieldhouse as a KSAC feature, describes KSAC as offering casual-game space, and says athletic-facility space is free to students.
cards.access_notes: Student recreation use is subject to facility availability; contact the KSAC office for current access details.

cards.title: Rally on the tennis courts
cards.subtitle: East of the Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Bring your own racquets and balls, then use a court for a relaxed rally. The courts sit east of KSAC and include outdoor restrooms.
cards.short_summary: Nine campus tennis courts designated for Taylor student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says its nine tennis courts provide space for student recreation and that athletic-facility space is free to students.
cards.access_notes: Bring any personal equipment needed and yield to scheduled Taylor tennis activity.

cards.title: Play a pickleball set
cards.subtitle: East of the Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Organize doubles or rotate partners on the outdoor pickleball courts. Bring paddles and a ball, and check that the courts are not reserved.
cards.short_summary: Eight outdoor pickleball courts in Taylor’s athletic neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says its eight pickleball courts provide space for student recreation and that athletic-facility space is free to students.
cards.access_notes: Bring any personal equipment needed and yield to scheduled Taylor tennis activity.

cards.title: Use the pool during general student hours
cards.subtitle: Kesler Student Activities Center
cards.notes: Check the current select-hour schedule, then meet for general pool use. Plan around athletic training and class activity, which also use the facility.
cards.short_summary: A two-lane lap pool that Taylor opens for general student use at select times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor says the Eichling Aquatics Wing pool is open for general student use during select hours and that athletic-facility space is free to students.
cards.access_notes: General student pool hours vary throughout the year; contact Taylor’s listed KSAC contact for current availability.

cards.title: Pause at Memorial Prayer Chapel
cards.subtitle: Central campus, between academic and residential buildings
cards.notes: Gather quietly with a small group in the chapel, then leave room for others seeking reflection. The building also has two private prayer rooms and outdoor alcoves.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel purpose-built for prayer, with space for a residence-hall group.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor describes Memorial Prayer Chapel as created specifically for prayer, with a 75-seat chapel, private prayer rooms, and outdoor alcoves.
cards.access_notes: Use this as a quiet, reflective space and respect private rooms and other visitors.

cards.entity_name: Taylor Chapel at Rediger Chapel & Auditorium
cards.title: Attend a Taylor chapel service
cards.subtitle: LaRita Boren Campus Center
cards.notes: Meet before the 10 a.m. service, sit together in Rediger, and stay afterward to compare reflections. Services include student-led worship and speakers.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus worship gathering in Rediger Chapel & Auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor states that chapel convenes Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10 a.m. in Rediger Auditorium and that attendance is not monitored.
cards.access_notes: Regular chapel is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10 a.m. in the LaRita Boren Student Center; campus schedules can change.
